conviction_note: FY26 was pre-released in line with the GBP52-56m adjusted operating profit guide on 2026-08-06, so the move lives in the lines the 13 Oct release adds: the first FY27 guide, the strategy update the company folded in instead of the Capital Markets Day it had promised before FY26 year-end, the size of the buyback that replaces the dividend, and possibly a Shopper review update. None of those has a sourced bar, so the findings are small and roughly offset (sum +0.4). abs_move is set on the guidance-event base (~9%) and this name's own results-day median of 11.45%. p_up is 46 because the last three results days fell 10-12% each, including FY25, which ran the same script (+17% on the August trading update, then -10.6% on results), and the stock is up about 67% from its March low. The sum and the scaled number differ in sign because the findings are content-level and the reaction history is a pattern, and the pattern is placed in p_up rather than inflated into a finding.

already_public.what: FY26 (year to 31 July 2026) full-year performance 'in line with the previously issued guidance at our HY26 results', i.e. adjusted operating profit GBP52-56m; banking facility extended to April 2028 with a EUR20m instalment due Oct 2027; buyback to start after the FY26 results in lieu of the FY26 dividend; Wayne Levings CEO-elect from 1 Nov 2026

FY26 adjusted operating profit guide GBP52-56m incl. GBP6m incremental Shopper investment; Value Delivery Plan Wave 1 worth GBP2.5m to FY27, Waves 1+2 >350bps annualised margin uplift vs H1 FY26 margin of 12.3%; Shopper strategic review commenced; 80% of FY26 revenue contracted
Notice of Results: FY26 results Tuesday 13 Oct 2026, 10:00 BST presentation 'will include an overview and discussion of the results, in addition to an update on the Group's strategy'

new_in_release.expect: First FY27 guide. The company's own VDP arithmetic (Wave 1 GBP2.5m, Waves 1+2 >350bps vs 12.3% H1 margin) points to FY27 profit up from GBP52-56m. Whether that meets the sell-side bar is unknown, because no bar is sourced. The last two first guides or guide resets (Oct 2025, Mar 2026) were sold 10-12%.

Strategy update replacing the promised pre-FY26-end Capital Markets Day: VDP Wave 3 ('margin profile aligned with an AI-led data business') and possibly medium-term targets. Adds variance; direction unknown.

Buyback size and timing, in lieu of the FY26 dividend. Likely modest given 2.1x leverage at H1 and the EUR20m Oct 2027 instalment. Mild positive if it is above the dividend equivalent, mild negative if it is token.
Possible update on the Shopper (ex-GfK CPS) strategic review. A disposal at a decent price would be a large positive; ending the review or retaining the business would be negative. Unknown.
FY26 free cash flow and net debt / leverage. Unknown; leverage was 2.1x at H1.

findings.finding: The buyback replacing the FY26 dividend is due to start straight after the results closed period, and its size is first disclosed in this release. The board says the intrinsic-value dislocation 'continues', and the bank terms were amended to permit it, which gives a near-term bid in a ~GBP316m market cap.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback was first flagged with the HY26 results (2026-03-24, -11.6% on the profit guide) and confirmed on 2026-08-06, when the stock closed +5.0% (261.2p to 274.2p). There is no prior instance of a sized buyback.
findings.why_not_priced: The intention is priced; the size is not public. If the market expected a large buyback, the stock would have moved on the 6 Aug RNS beyond the 5% it did and held there. Instead it gave the move back to 252.6p within four sessions and has sat at 261-272p since. Leverage of 2.1x and the EUR20m Oct 2027 instalment cap what is affordable, so the size could also disappoint, hence the range.
findings.independence: Same document as the banking-facility news, and the HY26 RNS stated the intention first (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/yougov--you/results-for-the-six-months-to-31-january-2026/9487884); not independent.

findings.finding: The release carries the first FY27 guide, and the company's own Value Delivery Plan numbers (Wave 1 GBP2.5m to FY27; Waves 1+2 >350bps annualised margin uplift vs the H1 FY26 12.3% margin) mechanically point to FY27 adjusted operating profit above the FY26 GBP52-56m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance lines have been sold. The FY25 results (2025-10-14), which carried the first FY26 guide with extra Shopper investment, fell 10.6%. The HY26 results (2026-03-24), which set GBP52-56m, fell 11.6%. The Feb 2026 half-year trading update coincided with a ~14% weekly fall.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The VDP numbers are the company's own guidance, so a guide inside them is what the market was told to expect, and the finding sits near 0. What is not public is the FY27 number itself and whether the GBP6m Shopper investment recurs. With no sourced consensus this stays capped small.
findings.independence: NIQ raised its FY26 guide on 2026-08-10 (EMEA OCC +4.9%), which weakly supports the Shopper/consumer-panel demand line (https://s206.q4cdn.com/369095886/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/NIQ-Press-Release-Q2-26-FINAL.pdf). That is a proxy, filed separately below.

findings.finding: The Capital Markets Day the company promised for 'prior to the end of FY26' (the year ended 31 July 2026) did not take place: no CMD RNS or presentation is in the record. The results-day presentation now carries 'an update on the Group's strategy' instead, so VDP Wave 3 and any medium-term targets land on this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior strategy reset on a results day under this management. The last CMD (2023) is outside the reaction history.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether the market has registered this slippage cannot be observed, and the content of the update is unknown. The finding raises the variance of the day (abs_move) rather than its sign, so it is sized at 0. The CEO handover on 1 Nov 2026 means the outgoing CEO is presenting the strategy, which makes the reception harder to call.
findings.independence: HY26 RNS promise: 'The Company will host a Capital Markets Day prior to the end of FY26' (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/yougov--you/results-for-the-six-months-to-31-january-2026/9487884). The IR presentations page lists no CMD after 2023 (https://corporate.yougov.com/investors/presentations/).

findings.finding: The Shopper strategic review is still live (on 2026-08-06 the bank extension was described as giving 'flexibility as it conducts the strategic review of the Shopper business'), and the closest listed counterparty, NIQ, raised its 2026 guide on 2026-08-10 with EMEA OCC +4.9%. Both point to a supportive backdrop for any Shopper outcome disclosed at results.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The review was announced on 2026-03-24 alongside the profit guide (-11.6%). No outcome has been announced since.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market were pricing a Shopper disposal on this print, there would be a bid premium or a press report naming buyers, and the September tape shows neither. A sell-side note naming Circana as a buyer was seen only as a search snippet and is not load-bearing. The outcome is binary and undated, and it may not land on 13 Oct at all, so this is sized small and positive with a wide range. The NIQ link is a proxy.
findings.independence: NIQ Q2 2026 release (https://s206.q4cdn.com/369095886/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/NIQ-Press-Release-Q2-26-FINAL.pdf), a different issuer and document.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no measured YouGov reaction to an Ipsos print.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It predates YouGov's own 6 Aug update, which already reflected H2. It is a macro-to-company proxy for the FY27 opening and carries little weight.

findings.finding: This name sells its results days, and this print runs the FY25 script. The last three results announcements moved -11.29%, -10.59% and -11.61%. The FY25 one (2025-10-14) followed an August trading update that had rallied the stock +17%. This year the 6 Aug update rallied it +5%, and the stock has risen from ~162p in March to 270p into the print.
findings.why_not_priced: A reaction pattern is not information the market lacks, so this mostly belongs in p_up. It is filed because the 67% rally since March means the stock now discounts a recovery, so a guide merely in line with VDP arithmetic has room to disappoint. The FY25 analogue shows exactly that. The 2026-10-12 date is the page read; each move is on the dated RNS row.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean (+1.53, mostly short_squeeze on a 1.57% register) and the flat 20-day run-up point mildly up. The strong 60-day (+10.7%) and since-March (+67%) rally, together with three straight -10% to -12% results days, cut against it. So p_up sits just under 50 while the content findings net slightly positive, and the scaled number (-0.8) is opposite in sign to the findings sum (+0.4).
language_note: Nothing the English sources did not already carry. The domestic-UK sources (Investegate RNS text, the FCA per-holder register) were the primary documents for every finding. What they added over the wire and aggregator snippets was precision rather than new facts: the exact 6 Aug wording that the Shopper review is ongoing, the slipped CMD (visible only by reading the HY26 RNS promise against the RNS list and IR presentations page), and the quant-fund composition of the short register.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' plus 'too small about the move': the first FY27 guide and the folded-in strategy update are scheduled guidance events, so abs_move_pct was raised from 8.0 to 10.0 (guidance base ~9%, the name's own results-day median 11.45%). This moved expected_move_pct from -0.64 to -0.80.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': checked. FY26 was already carried as already_public and rejected as a duplicate, not filed, so no finding changed.
'Let the reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct': kept p_up at 46 and did not cap abs_move on the reaction history. Findings unchanged (sum +0.4).
